_comment: Generated by tools/make-asset-manifest.mjs. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run manifest`. An entry carries a `url` when the physical file is not at the logical name - that is the whole point of the indirection - and it is omitted wherever the two are equal, which is everywhere except the retired names listed in the generator. Hashes are subresource-integrity form and are recorded, not enforced; see AssetResolver for why that is a deployment decision.
